caption: The drawing depicts three views of an oval-shaped object arranged vertically near the center of a plain, beige background. At the top center, there is a colored illustration of the object, which features an intricate design in yellow and brown tones, consisting of intertwining, curved forms and what appear to be stylized animal shapes within an oval border. Below this, two pencil sketches in grayscale are positioned side by side. The left sketch shows a front view of the oval object, reproducing the same pattern as the colored illustration but without color, while the right sketch presents a side profile, indicating the object's thickness and the raised nature of its design. No other objects or details are present on the otherwise empty background.
title: Pin
